verdict: Cost per lead dropped sharply; volume remains too thin to celebrate yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 7 leads at a cost per lead of $249.37 — a lean volume period, though the cost per lead itself fell nearly 50% compared to the prior 7 days, which is a real efficiency gain. Search clicks went dark over September 7–10, dropping to zero for four consecutive days, which is being investigated and addressed now. Several planned milestones — including the booking bot and intake confirmation — are overdue, and clearing those is the direct path to unlocking higher lead volume. Heating campaigns are on track to go live October 1, so next period should bring meaningfully more activity as seasonal demand builds.
